claim: The interface review also confirms that the provisional terminology decision is valid, but guide 1.1 must include productor del fondo and its equivalence to records creator.
evidence: The new interface distinguishes author, records creator and audiovisual producer. We need to check whether the labels are understandable to non-specialist users.
In Spanish, autor and productor audiovisual are clear. For records creator, I prefer productor del fondo in the interface, accompanied by a short explanation.
In English, I would retain records creator. We should not display creator without qualification, because that would reintroduce the ambiguity from guide version 1.0.
I can add contextual help and retain the technical term in the metadata.
